status: Locally verified purecore solid-remesh foundation; not DynaMesh, quad retopology or SculptGL parity.
algorithm: Independent oriented scanline solid occupancy; truncated two-voxel unsigned distance via triangle BVH; consistent six-tetrahedra cube extraction; bounded paired local shrink/expand smoothing; nearest-original-surface barycentric mask/RGB interpolation.
solid_policy: Each consistently wound closed component is treated as a filled solid, inward orientation normalized, positive-winding union of components. Cavities represented by inward nested components are filled; not a general shell/void interpretation.
original_preservation: Original project SHA256 unchanged after all operations; all remesh outputs are separate ignored files.

independent_fixture_definitions.sphere-4: Unit icosphere with4linear-projection refinements,2562V/5120T; authored by OBrush primitive.
independent_fixture_definitions.sharp-box: Unit halfextent cube linearly subdivided4times; analyticvolume8.
independent_fixture_definitions.overlapping-boxes: Two such cubes translated by +/-0.5 onX; expectedunionvolume12; input componentvolumes total16.
independent_fixture_definitions.face-touching-boxes: Two such cubes translated by +/-1 onX; expectedunionvolume16.

acceptance_tolerances.barycentric_spatial_attribute_error: Less than1voxel on analytical linear scalar/RGB box fixture. Constantchannel tolerance1e-6.
acceptance_tolerances.closed_manifold: Each edge has exactly2faces with opposite winding; each vertex link is oneconnectedfan; every triangle has nonzero area; allmeshfieldsfinite/valid.

commands: cargo clippy --locked -p obrush-core --lib --test remesh --example remesh_probe -- -D warnings
native_scope: Single release CLI timing per fixture/resolution; excludes JSON input/output. Not browser latency, hardwareinput or nativeGUI evidence.

failure_receipts.failure: Unconstrained paired geometry smoothing inverted healthy sphere triangles (sphere64:120 edges over90 degrees). Both sphere/user96 exceeded initial work budget before two-voxel distance truncation.

failure_receipts.limitation: Healthy sphere fold fix passed, but .002voxel distance floor left needle faces on user sculpt; raised floor to.02voxel.

failure_receipts.failure: Concurrent decimation source strict warning; own files no warnings reported.

failure_receipts.trial: Exactly one six-neighbor signed-field smoothing pass, with a maximum field-value change of 0.25 voxel. The experimental setting and algorithm were removed from production after failing the actual user-model quality and weighted-fold gates.
failure_receipts.result: Rejected. User model at resolution64: fold length2.2580 to2.2960, severity0.80861 to1.04229, maximum fold153.8 to167.3 degrees. Resolution32 split2components into5. Improved healthy-box corners do not override the actual-model regression. The symmetric distance audit was not run after the geometry gate had already failed.

limitations: Voxel resolution changes shape and may erase thin features or merge close solids. User sculpt32 splits a tiny component;64/96 remain connected.
Source has holes/nonmanifold/inconsistent winding/zero area/pathological triangles: operation rejects atomically rather than repairing unknown solids.
Marching tetrahedra returns triangles, not quads or persistent subdivision; density and quality differ by surface orientation.
User damaged sculpt remains imperfect: default64 foldworldlength2.258 vs original1.019, so no damage-repair promotion.
Nearest-surface attributes interpolate existing values; mask values transfer but topology/positions of protected vertices do not remain fixed.
Tests do not establish global self-intersection absence after smoothing, thin-surface preservation, peak memory, physical latency or reference parity.
Input component volume includes overlapping regions multiply; it is not expected union volume.
Time is one native release CLI measurement per fixture/resolution, excludes input JSON parsing/output JSON saving, not browser benchmark.
